chapter: Long Island years and Battle's estate
title: Marriages and raising children
summary: After that last big tour he married, has had three or four wives, and ended up raising the children himself.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, after you'd done this tour, did you do other things like that?
No, that was the last one. That was a
big tour. I come back and I think that's when I got married. When I got married, (inaudible) Long Island.
What do you mean, you got married? Hadn't you been married before?
No, not while I was out on the road with that band. No.
That was the first time you were married?
No, I've had three or four wives. (Laughter.) I didn't stay with them long. Yeah, married right after I come off of that tour.

And when the wife got some kids, which we got involved into accidentally, then I say, well, I just try to help take care of these kids because she was kind of young and seemed unstable. So, I said, oh well, I'm stuck. So I'm just going to have to be a mother and a father. (Laughter.) Which wasn't so good, but I wasn't ready for too much -- I've never been ready for too much married life. I think I'm a lone wolf. (Laughter.) But I like kids.
Well, you evidently like women, too.
